summary: ansible.windows dsc3 check mode now runs dsc config set --what-if instead of dsc config test, and group resources fail in check mode.
questions: How does dsc3 check mode work in Ansible 15?
Why does Microsoft.DSC/Group fail in check mode?

answer_card.title: dsc3 check mode uses --what-if
answer_card.answer_md: `ansible.windows.dsc3` check mode now runs `dsc config set --what-if` instead of `dsc config test`, so reported changes match what `dsc` would do. Group resources such as `Microsoft.DSC/Group` and `Microsoft.DSC/Include` don't support what-if and **fail in check mode**.
